Market today: Tech is getting hammered, especially chips, which is hitting your book hard. The Nasdaq sell-off is the main driver here.

Your holdings: SMCI (-38.29%), SOXL (-81.82%), MU (-66.07%), SPAL (-56.98%), PLTU (-35.9%), and SMH (-29.64%) are all deep in the red and need attention. CRWD (24.16%) is your only significant winner but is marked SELL.

Watch: The chip sector weakness is the primary concern. Keep an eye on how the broader market indices like SPY and QQQ behave.

Bottom line: Your concentrated tech/chip book is facing significant headwinds, amplified by margin. Focus on managing risk in your leveraged positions.
plays: Trim SOXL: Given the -81.82% PnL and leveraged decay, consider reducing exposure if it breaks below its current price.
Trim SMCI: Down -38.29%, this name is struggling. Consider trimming if it shows no immediate signs of recovery.
Consider SOXS: Scanner shows a LONG setup (entry 77.67-77.17, stop 74.07). If you're looking to hedge or play the downside in semis, this is a potential option.
